# yebeyt

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): it has the project rules, the build and check commands, and the three-tier way of working. For yebeyt 2.0 work also read [docs/yebeyt-2.md](../docs/yebeyt-2.md).

In chat, pick the **lead** agent (`.github/agents/lead.agent.md`); it hands code to **builder**, reviews to **reviewer**, and mechanical work to **mechanic**.
